faq.title: Answers that keep your rollout on track.

launch.question: How fast can we launch?
launch.answer: Most customers go live in under two weeks: connect PMS, add email templates, invite staff. We provide migration templates and proven onboarding playbooks.

compliance.question: What compliance coverage is included?
compliance.answer: We ship with configurable legal forms for multiple regions. Export reports directly for authorities with the same encryption standards proven across our remote check-in workflows.

extend.question: Can we extend the platform?
extend.answer: Yes. Use our REST and webhook APIs to connect marketing automation, housekeeping platforms, or custom guest apps. SDKs ship with authentication helpers and sample bots.

mobile.question: Do you support mobile-first experiences?
mobile.answer: Absolutely. Guests can complete journey on any device, with real-time validation optimised for cameras and offline capture queues for limited connectivity.

payment.question: What payment methods do you accept?
payment.answer: We accept all major credit cards, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and bank transfers for Enterprise plans. All payments are processed securely through PCI-compliant providers.

data.question: How is our guest data protected?
data.answer: All guest data is encrypted end-to-end, stored in secure data centers, and handled according to GDPR and hospitality privacy regulations. You retain full data ownership and can export it anytime.

mixPlans.question: Can we mix plans across properties?
mixPlans.answer: Yes. You can run different plans per property and consolidate billing monthly. Enterprise gives you rollout governance.

perGuest.question: Do you charge per guest?
perGuest.answer: No. Every plan includes unlimited guests and reservations. You only pay based on the feature set that matches your operation.

annualDiscount.question: How does the annual discount work?
annualDiscount.answer: Annual billing gives you two months off (pay for 10, get 12). You can upgrade or downgrade at any time with a prorated invoice.

onboarding.question: Is onboarding included?
onboarding.answer: Launch includes a self-serve template library. Growth and Enterprise customers receive dedicated onboarding sessions and migration assistance.

hero.title: Everything you need to know about Remote Check-in
hero.description: Find answers to common questions about setup, features, pricing, technical requirements, compliance, and support.

setup.question: How do I set up Remote Check-in for my property?
setup.answer: Setting up Remote Check-in is straightforward. After signing up, you'll connect your PMS (Property Management System) or upload guest lists manually. Configure your email templates, invite your team members, and you're ready to start sending check-in invitations to guests. Our onboarding team provides step-by-step guidance and migration templates to make the process seamless.

onboarding.question: What onboarding support is included?
onboarding.answer: Launch plan includes access to our self-serve template library and community support. Growth and Enterprise customers receive dedicated onboarding sessions with our team, migration assistance, and priority support. We provide proven playbooks, integration guides, and best practices to ensure a smooth rollout.

timeToLaunch.question: How fast can we go live?
timeToLaunch.answer: Most customers go live in under two weeks. The timeline depends on your PMS integration complexity and customization needs. Simple setups can be operational within days, while custom implementations may take 2-4 weeks. Our team works with you to establish a realistic timeline based on your requirements.

training.question: Is staff training included?
training.answer: Yes, we provide comprehensive training resources including video tutorials, documentation, and best practice guides. Growth and Enterprise plans include live training sessions for your team. We also offer ongoing support to help your staff become proficient with the platform.

documents.question: What types of documents can guests upload?
documents.answer: Guests can upload identity documents including passports, national ID cards, driver's licenses, and other government-issued IDs. The system supports front and back images of documents, plus a selfie with the document for identity verification. All uploads are encrypted and stored securely.

languages.question: Which languages are supported?
languages.answer: Remote Check-in supports 12+ languages including English, Italian, Spanish, French, German, and more. The guest interface automatically detects the user's browser language or allows manual selection. You can also customize translations for your brand's specific terminology.

mobile.question: Do guests need a mobile app?
mobile.answer: No mobile app is required. Guests complete the check-in process through any web browser on their smartphone, tablet, or computer. The interface is optimized for mobile devices with real-time validation, camera integration for document capture, and offline queue support for areas with limited connectivity.

notifications.question: How do guests receive check-in invitations?
notifications.answer: Guests receive branded invitations via email or SMS (available in Growth and Enterprise plans). Invitations include a secure link to complete their check-in. You can customize email templates with your branding, property information, and local tips. Automated reminders are sent for incomplete check-ins.

customization.question: Can I customize the guest experience?
customization.answer: Yes, Growth and Enterprise plans include brandable guest portals where you can customize colors, logos, messaging, and add property-specific content. You can also create custom workflows, add upsell opportunities, and integrate with your existing systems for a seamless brand experience.

plans.question: What's the difference between Launch, Growth, and Enterprise plans?
plans.answer: Launch is free for the first 20 subscribers and includes core features like document capture, automated emails, and unlimited properties. Growth adds brandable portals, SMS notifications, PMS integrations, and priority support. Enterprise offers custom implementations, dedicated success managers, advanced analytics, regional compliance workflows, and SSO.

billing.question: How does billing work?
billing.answer: You can choose monthly or annual billing. Annual billing saves you 2 months (pay for 10, get 12). All plans include unlimited guests and reservations—you only pay based on the feature set. Enterprise plans have custom pricing based on your specific needs. You can upgrade or downgrade at any time with prorated billing.

cancellation.question: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
cancellation.answer: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time. There are no long-term contracts or cancellation fees. When you cancel, you'll retain access until the end of your current billing period. Your data remains available for export for 30 days after cancellation.

trial.question: Is there a free trial?
trial.answer: The Launch plan is free for the first 20 hospitality teams, which serves as our free tier. For Growth and Enterprise plans, we offer a 14-day free trial so you can explore all features. No credit card required for the trial period.

refund.question: What is your refund policy?
refund.answer: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee for all paid plans. If you're not satisfied within the first 30 days, contact our support team for a full refund. After 30 days, refunds are handled on a case-by-case basis for annual subscriptions.

integration.question: Which PMS systems do you integrate with?
integration.answer: We offer native integrations with major PMS providers and support two-way synchronization via REST APIs and webhooks. Popular integrations include systems like Mews, Cloudbeds, Little Hotelier, and many others. We can also build custom integrations for your specific PMS through our Enterprise plan.

api.question: Do you provide API access?
api.answer: Yes, all plans include API access. Our REST API and webhook ecosystem allow you to build custom integrations, automate workflows, and connect Remote Check-in with your existing tools. We provide comprehensive API documentation, authentication helpers, and sample code to get you started.

selfHost.question: Can I self-host Remote Check-in?
selfHost.answer: Yes, we offer self-hosting options for complete control over your infrastructure and data residency. You can deploy on your own servers using Docker containers and infrastructure-as-code scripts. We also support hybrid deployments where select properties sync to our cloud while others remain on-premises.

requirements.question: What are the technical requirements?
requirements.answer: Remote Check-in is a cloud-based SaaS that requires no installation on your end. Guests only need a modern web browser and internet connection. For self-hosting, you'll need servers capable of running Docker containers, S3-compatible storage, and standard web infrastructure. We provide detailed infrastructure requirements in our deployment guide.

uptime.question: What is your uptime guarantee?
uptime.answer: We maintain 99.9% uptime SLA for our hosted service. Our infrastructure is built on redundant systems with automatic failover, regular backups, and 24/7 monitoring. Enterprise customers receive additional SLA guarantees and dedicated infrastructure options for mission-critical deployments.

gdpr.question: Is Remote Check-in GDPR compliant?
gdpr.answer: Yes, Remote Check-in is fully GDPR compliant. We implement data encryption, access controls, right to deletion, and all required privacy measures. Guest data is encrypted end-to-end, and you retain full data ownership. You can export or delete guest data at any time through the admin dashboard.

portaleAlloggi.question: Does it integrate with Portale Alloggi?
portaleAlloggi.answer: Yes, Remote Check-in includes automated integration with Italy's Portale Alloggi (accommodation registry). The system automatically submits required guest data in the correct format, ensuring compliance with Italian hospitality regulations. This feature is available in all plans and can be configured in your settings.

dataRetention.question: How long is guest data stored?
dataRetention.answer: You control data retention policies through your admin settings. By default, data is retained according to local hospitality regulations (typically 5-7 years for compliance purposes). You can configure automatic deletion schedules or manually delete data. All deletions are permanent and irreversible.

audit.question: Are audit trails available?
audit.answer: Yes, all plans include comprehensive audit logs tracking user actions, data access, system changes, and compliance submissions. Enterprise plans include advanced audit features with detailed reporting, export capabilities, and integration with your existing audit systems. All logs are tamper-proof and retained according to your retention policies.

regions.question: Which regions and regulations are supported?
regions.answer: We support compliance requirements for multiple regions including Italy (Portale Alloggi), GDPR (European Union), and other major hospitality markets. Our compliance forms are configurable and updated regularly to reflect current regulations. Enterprise customers can request custom compliance workflows for specific regional requirements.

contact.question: How can I contact support?
contact.answer: Launch plan customers can access community support forums and email support. Growth and Enterprise customers receive priority in-app and email support with faster response times. Enterprise customers also get a dedicated success manager. For urgent issues, Enterprise customers have access to phone support during business hours.

responseTime.question: What are your support response times?
responseTime.answer: Launch plan: Community support and email responses within 48 hours. Growth plan: Priority email support with responses within 24 hours on business days. Enterprise plan: Dedicated support with responses within 4 hours during business hours, plus a dedicated success manager for proactive assistance.

documentation.question: Where can I find documentation?
documentation.answer: Comprehensive documentation is available in our help center, covering setup guides, API references, integration tutorials, best practices, and troubleshooting. All customers have access to video tutorials, step-by-step guides, and our knowledge base. Enterprise customers receive custom documentation for their specific implementation.

community.question: Is there a community or forum?
community.answer: Yes, we have an active community where users share tips, ask questions, and vote on product roadmap features. Launch plan customers have full access to community forums. We also host regular webinars, office hours, and user meetups to help you get the most out of Remote Check-in.
